changelog.zh: Cursor composer-2.5 按 12 轮额度读数区间发布有条件估算，并按标准 API 公开价折合 USD；套餐档位改为未核验，解除与 Ultra 套餐卡片的关联。Codex Pro 200 新增按 OpenAI gpt-6-astra 公开价计算的 USD 等价价值。
changelog.en: Publish Cursor composer-2.5 as a conditional estimate from the 12-call meter interval with a standard API list-price USD equivalent; mark the plan tier unverified and detach it from the Ultra plan card. Add a USD equivalent for Codex Pro 200 at OpenAI gpt-6-astra list price.

note.zh: 标准 API 档。本样本单次输入最高 93,822 tokens，未触发 >272K 输入的长上下文加价。缓存写入为 0。
note.en: Standard API tier. Long-context surcharge (>272K input per request) not triggered: max per-call input in this sample is 93,822 tokens. Cache writes were 0.

caveats.zh: 仅适用于 ChatGPT Pro 200，档位由账号持有人确认。本轮 Astra 主测 28 次，控制会话 token 计数未变；约 10.45% 为缓存读取。范围仅含读数舍入，仍假设线性扣量、计量已结算且无其他设备流量。5 小时/月窗口未返回；Sol 读数异常，暂不发布容量。
caveats.en: Applies only to ChatGPT Pro 200; tier confirmed by the account owner. Astra main batch: 28 calls with unchanged controller token counters. Bounds cover meter rounding only, assuming linear consumption, settled meters and no other-device traffic. No 5-hour/monthly window returned; Sol capacity withheld due to inconsistent readings.

tierVerification.note: Account owner confirmed the measured plan is Pro 200, not Pro 100 or Pro 500. This is not independent billing verification.

caveats.zh: 30 次、3 批同模型实测，约 98.31% 为普通输入，无缓存命中或写入。三窗口分别测量，月额度为粗估。区间仅含读数舍入误差，仍假设线性扣量及无其他账号流量；不是跨模型通用 token 上限。
caveats.en: 30 calls in 3 batches, one model, about 98.31% fresh input and no cache reads/writes. Each window measured directly; monthly capacity is rough. Bounds cover meter rounding only and assume linear consumption without other account traffic; not a universal cross-model token cap.

tierVerification.note: The earlier record labelled this account Cursor Ultra (legacy), but neither the report nor the ledger contains tier evidence. Only the legacy two-pool layout (Cursor Models + Other Models, on-demand usage) is observed; the specific legacy tier is not verified.

excluded.reason: No final meter reading after the browser disconnected

note.zh: composer-2.5 标准公开价。产品默认 Fast 版本（输入 $3 / 缓存读取 $0.50 / 输出 $15）；账本只记录请求模型 composer-2.5，实际计费版本未核验。
note.en: Standard composer-2.5 list price. Cursor's Fast variant ($3 input / $0.50 cache read / $15 output) is the in-product default; the ledger only records the requested model id composer-2.5, so the variant actually billed is not verified.

caveats.zh: 有条件实测，非官方承诺：仅前 12 轮（801,760 tokens）对应额度 34.7423% → 34.7570%；第 4 批未计入，CSV 未对账。窗口按旧套餐月度 Cursor Models 池处理，重置点未核验，套餐档位未核验。USD 为标准公开价估值，不是余额；假设线性扣量且无其他流量，区间仅覆盖仪表读数舍入。
caveats.en: Conditional measurement, not an official allowance: only the first 12 calls (801,760 tokens) match 34.7423% → 34.7570%; batch 4 excluded, CSV not reconciled. Treated as the legacy monthly Cursor Models pool; reset point not verified, plan tier unverified. USD is a standard list-price valuation, not a credit balance; assumes linear consumption and no other traffic, with bounds covering meter rounding only.

publicationPolicy: Observations and conditional estimates only; no official allowance, automatic monthly extrapolation, or authoritative plan-tier assignment. USD equivalents are valuations at public standard API list prices, not credit balances.
